Lemma
[Linear-growth scalar curvature on a net (Lemma 27.20)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0034, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0035 1. ch27:27.20\group Scalar curvature bounds

For every $\delta >0$ on a normalized noncompact shrinker, outside a compact set each $x$ has a point $y\in B_x(\delta )$ satisfying $R(y)\le C(n,\delta )(d(y,O)+1)$, where $O$ minimizes $f$.
